description: Abwasserleitungsnetz Stadt Springe is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by springe.de. The sewer network consists of rainwater, wastewater and mixed water channels. The data is continuously updated. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Sewage network City of Springe" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspireidentifiziert. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
